title: Duck
blurb: Duck is the common name for numerous species of waterfowl in the family Anatidae. Ducks are generally smaller and shorter-necked than swans and geese, which are members of the same family.
facts: Divided among several subfamilies, they are a form taxon; they do not represent a monophyletic group, since swans and geese are not considered ducks.
Ducks are mostly aquatic birds, and may be found in both fresh water and sea water.
